source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 21 May 1949, p. 5 ("Tyrone County Council")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)

note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Cookstown rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There were no contests; S. Park withdrew in Stewartstown, and J. Doris was deemed re-elected in Mullanahoe, where no nomination was received. Printed as 'Major Alexander, M.C., D.L.'; the same member appears as Major C. A. Alexander in the 1946 return. Returned unopposed.
